messages:
maria_cs: Quick capture from ApertureHealth onboarding call (14:10 PT). Finance paused their pilot after a sudden embedding cost run-up. Pasting raw asks for Product/ENG triage.

maria_cs: Top asks (customer language):
- a single CFO-ready export that rolls up spend by workspace/project with daily lines and a simple total; they want an attachable file for procurement.
- ability to configure "vector retention" (server-side TTL) per workspace so nightly reindex jobs don't re-trigger full embedding.
- an option to 'lock' a route to the exact model hash during pilots and surface an explicit fallback if that hash is unavailable.
- clearer throttling diagnostics in logs (want reason codes like `quota|burst|concurrency` and suggested remediation steps).
- a compact onboarding digest e-mail (day 0-7) summarizing tokens, embed calls, cost and top error types.

rachel_prod: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the workspace id + an example date/time for the spike so ENG can pull traces? Also confirm retention = hard eviction vs soft flag?

maria_cs: Workspace: aperture-prod-7. Spike sample: 2026-03-20 UTC (approx 02:30). They asked for hard eviction TTL (e.g., 24h / 7d) so vectors stop being reused after window.

devon_se: I can grab metrics and a graf snapshot for that window. Short-term workaround: create a workspace tag and offer a manual billing CSV grouped by tag while we build the Console export.

devon_se: Note on model lock: rollout system supports version pinning but Console lacks a one-click control. We could add a small "freeze" toggle that sets rollout weight=100 for the selected model in the short term.

lee_eng: I'll investigate the 03/20 window and check for overlapping batch jobs or client-retry loops that could cause extra embed calls. Also agree TTL will require storage/eviction logic review; flagging possible downstream index coupling.

rachel_prod: Proposal: split into two workstreams: 1) Billing transparency (CFO-ready export + daily rollup + onboarding digest) = highest priority for renewal. 2) Operational controls (vector TTL + route freeze + better 429 reasons) = next sprint/backlog. Thoughts?

maria_cs: Customer explicitly said: "We need one sheet to show procurement or they will postpone the contract." So billing transparency is urgent.

notify_bot: Created ticket INF-6120 for CFO-ready workspace export (https://jira.redwood/INF-6120). Created ticket INF-6121 for onboarding 0-7 digest (https://jira.redwood/INF-6121).

lee_eng: I'll attach Grafana links and a short repro to INF-6120 by EOD. For TTL feasibility, I will open an investigation note in INF-6120 comments.

devon_se: I'll draft a minimal CSV schema for the CFO use-case (fields: day, workspace, route, model, embed_calls, tokens_in, tokens_out, est_cost_usd, total_usd) and add it to INF-6120 for CS feedback.

rachel_prod: Owners/ETAs (tentative):
- INF-6120 (CFO export): owner=rachel_prod, ETA=8 business days
- INF-6121 (onboarding digest email): owner=rachel_prod, ETA=2 weeks
- Vector TTL investigation: owner=lee_eng, ETA=investigation next sprint
- Route freeze UI experiment: owner=pm-ui, ETA=Q3 but consider quick toggle if trivial

maria_cs: Action items for CS: share ApertureHealth finance contact and confirm acceptance of manual tag-based CSV as short-term mitigation (owner=maria_cs) by tomorrow AM.

rachel_prod: One more ask for CS: please collect 2 prioritized CSV use-cases from Aperture (CFO summary + engineering incident analysis) so we can solidify columns.

maria_cs: Will DM finance and paste examples here tomorrow AM. Will also offer the manual export today so they can unpause the pilot ASAP. :thumbsup:

lee_eng: Quick note for ENG: when investigating, check KV cache churn and embedding client concurrency around 03/20; those are common culprits.

rachel_prod: Thanks team — keep updates concise here. If we need cross-team design we'll open a PRD.

notify_bot: Thread retention: 90 days.
